author: Grow Channels
title: 3 Claude Prompts to Grow YouTube Fast
one_liner: Use Claude AI and 3 specific prompts to research niches, analyze competitors, and generate viral YouTube video ideas.
key_points: Find niches using NexLev: target competitors with under 100k subs but over 500k monthly views
Prompt #1 (Channel Forensics): assign Claude as an Elite YouTube Title Strategist to reverse-engineer viral patterns in your niche
Prompt #2 (Competitor Research): feed Claude a competitor's channel blueprint PDF to extract title formats, thumbnail types, and view-count insights
Prompt #3 (Viral Video Ideas): provide Claude two documents — channel blueprint + your own data — to generate new high-potential video concepts
